scope: Fresh public source history, release contents, update trust chain, file/process boundaries and dependency licenses; not a guarantee that all vulnerabilities are absent.
excluded: Personal home paths and builder identity

verification.actualMacUpdateChain: 0.6.5 → 0.7.0 → 0.7.1 through in-app Install Update / Relaunch; 50 history records and automatic checks preserved; no new credentials
verification.windowsNativeScope: Windows runner with rendered WPF controls and real exports; no physical global Explorer gesture claimed
verification.actualWindowsUpdateChain: 0.7.0.0 → 0.7.1.0: anonymous public download, pinned archive signature, real portable replacement, new native window, graceful close and 38 updated-app native checks

updateTrust.mac: Pinned Ed25519 verification of feed and archive through Sparkle
updateTrust.windows: Pinned Ed25519 archive verification, canonical repository/size/version checks, safe extraction and recoverable previous app folder

dependencyDelivery: Large media and Office runtimes are acquired directly from upstream with pinned hashes; included libraries/source retain license notices. Windows PDFsharp is MIT 6.2.4; vulnerable transitive package overridden by patched 10.0.13.
knownLimits: No Apple notarization/Developer ID or Windows Authenticode signing in these initial builds.
Windows x64 is a native preview with fewer tools than macOS.
Complex media/document parsers and external upstream dependencies remain attack surfaces.
Public URL downloads depend on the remote site and do not import browser cookies.
